Definition: adverb from a compound of the accusative case of G3563 and G2192; in a mind-having way, i.e. prudently:--discreetly.
BiblicalUsage: Nounechos means answering with understanding, sensibly, with the mind engaged. The scribe answers Jesus discreetly in Mark 12:34, and Jesus tells him he is not far from the kingdom of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a thoughtful answer matters to Jesus, and understanding the great commandments puts a person nearer the kingdom than ritual ever could.
